title: audit detail session.context_saved
description: detail of audit rows with action session.context_saved: a device committed a context checkpoint (target_kind context) or a log (target_kind log, ADR-080 section 3) of the session: chunk count, size in bytes and the number of older objects of the same kind of the task deleted beyond the keep setting (ADR-072 sections 5 and 6). Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
